Management question: Where was the most money spent?
What it measures: Total recorded cost in constant 2021 currency

Management question: Which systems took the most technician time?
Which systems generate a steady flow of new work?
What it measures: Work-order count weighted by the share of quarters with work

Management question: Which systems produce unusually expensive jobs?
What it measures: Cost above the campus 95th percentile of per-work-order cost

Management question: Which systems make annual spending hardest to predict?
What it measures: Standard deviation of annual cost around its own mean scaled by the campus spending index
